## Paper

The Tragedy of the Commons

## World

resource_island

## Institution

No-institution common-pool resource baseline.

## Agent type

Resource users / spatial learning agents.

## Theoretical benchmark

Open-access common resources face depletion pressure when private extraction benefits exceed shared costs.

## Learning setup

Spatial resource gathering/trading with energy, inventories, regeneration, and learned policies.

## Metrics

Resource sustainability, survival, welfare, extraction/gathering, trade, inequality, specialization.

## Main result

The essay frames open-access common resources as vulnerable to overuse when individual extraction incentives impose shared costs. Use it as conceptual commons motivation, not as a literal prediction that depletion is inevitable in every designed environment.

## What they prove

Not a formal proof for this repo's purposes. It supplies a conceptual common-pool failure mode: private extraction incentives can conflict with collective resource sustainability.

## What they only simulate

Not applicable for this card's thesis use: it is conceptual/theoretical framing, not a simulation benchmark.

## What they do NOT test

Learning agents, explicit institution activation, trade protocols, property-opportunity counters, and reproducible multi-seed artificial-economy runs.

## What we need to reproduce

Resource Island must report depletion/sustainability and activation diagnostics, not only agent reward.

## How our project differs

The essay is a broad commons warning. The repo implements a stylized spatial inventory world to test whether institutions bind under learning agents.

## Implementation obligations

Sustainability metric; survival metric; gather/trade counters; regeneration accounting; institution activation diagnostics.

## Metrics to compare in our repo

resource_sustainability, survival, gather/trade diagnostics; Resource Island v0/v1 full outputs.

## Failure modes to audit

High survival despite depleted resources not explained; institutions inactive but interpreted as ineffective; whole-island trade treated as spatial trade without caveat.

## Project code comparison

Compare The Tragedy of the Commons to Resource Island outputs. The repo's useful contribution is diagnostic: when institutions do not bind, the design reason must be measured.
